Metric Prefixes

Source: R/constants.R
Prefix.Rd

SI metric prefixes from yotta (\(10^{24}\)) down to yocto (\(10^{-24}\)), with their name, symbol and multiplier. Used as default lookup table by convUnit and for SI-prefix formatting in fm.

Usage

Prefix

Format

A data.frame with 20 rows and 3 columns:

pref

character, name of the prefix (e.g. "kilo").

abbr

character, symbol of the prefix (e.g. "k"); "u" is used for micro.

mult

numeric, multiplier, i.e. the power of ten the prefix stands for (e.g. 1000).

Value

A data.frame as described under Format; the object is a constant, not a function.

Examples

Prefix
#>     pref abbr  mult
#> 1  yotta    Y 1e+24
#> 2  zetta    Z 1e+21
#> 3    exa    E 1e+18
#> 4   peta    P 1e+15
#> 5   tera    T 1e+12
#> 6   giga    G 1e+09
#> 7   mega    M 1e+06
#> 8   kilo    k 1e+03
#> 9  hecto    h 1e+02
#> 10  deca   da 1e+01
#> 11  deci    d 1e-01
#> 12 centi    c 1e-02
#> 13 milli    m 1e-03
#> 14 micro    u 1e-06
#> 15  nano    n 1e-09
#> 16  pico    p 1e-12
#> 17 femto    f 1e-15
#> 18  atto    a 1e-18
#> 19 zepto    z 1e-21
#> 20 yocto    y 1e-24
Prefix[Prefix$abbr == "k", ]
#>   pref abbr mult
#> 8 kilo    k 1000
